infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to capture event images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access photos to import event images.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to add events to your calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to add events to your calendar.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to extract calendar events from images.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to capture event images.

plugins.calendarPermission: The app needs to access your calendar to add events.
